```python
# Repeatedly removes innermost parenthesized groups and prints what is left
import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)
from collections import deque
from collections import defaultdict

n = int(input())
s = str(input())
s = list(s)

ans = []

    if mozi == "(":
        sakuzyo.append(i)
        ans.append(mozi)

    elif mozi == ")":
        if sakuzyo:

            del ans[sakuzyo.pop():]

        else:
            ans.append(mozi)
    else:
        ans.append(mozi)

print("".join(ans))
```
